name: AI Product Tools – Bulk Product Content Generator & AI Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: Dogu Pekgoz

sections.description:
AI Product Tools is a comprehensive AI suite designed to automate your WooCommerce operations and enhance customer experience. It combines high-volume bulk product content generation with a store-aware AI Shop Assistant, providing a complete infrastructure for both backend management and frontend sales support.

The plugin offers versatile workflows to suit any store management style:
* AI Bulk Product Content Generators: Trigger immediate, mass updates for Descriptions, Titles, Tags, and FAQs.
* AI Shop Assistant (Chatbot): A 24/7 intelligent sales agent that knows your entire catalog and store policies.
* Automation Jobs: Schedule fully automated background tasks (“set and forget”).
* Single Product Metabox: Fine-tune content directly inside the WooCommerce edit screen.

It integrates seamlessly with leading AI providers, giving you full control over model selection (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter), prompts, and generation strategies.

🤖 Key Features

  • AI Shop Assistant: An intelligent chatbot with a mobile-first tabbed interface that answers queries, recommends products, and integrates with WhatsApp.
  • AI Brand Voice (New): Define your store’s persona and tone settings globally to ensure the AI always writes in your brand’s unique voice.
  • Example Content Learning (New): Paste an example of your perfect product description, and the AI will mimic its structure and style exactly (Pro).
  • Unified AI Dashboard: Centralized control center to manage all generation tools from a single interface.
  • Mass Product Content Generation: Bulk process Descriptions, Titles, Tags, and FAQs for thousands of products.
  • Multi-Provider Support: Connect with leading AI models including OpenAI (GPT-5.2, GPT-4.1, O3/O4), Google Gemini (2.5, 3.0), and OpenRouter (300+ models).
  • Smart Context Analysis: The AI analyzes product categories, attributes, prices, and stock status to create factual, relevant content.
  • SEO & HTML Formatting: Automatically structures content with HTML markup and keywords. Now includes custom HTML tag selection.
  • Advanced Multi-Language System: Auto-detects visitor language from 42+ options with smart fallback support.

🛍️ AI Shop Assistant (Chatbot)

Transform your visitor experience with a fully store-aware AI agent. Unlike standard support bots, this assistant is deeply integrated with your WooCommerce catalog and features a modern, app-like interface.

  • Mobile-First Design: Features a sleek tabbed layout (“Home” & “Messages”) and collapsible product cards, providing an optimal experience on all devices.
  • WhatsApp Integration: Includes a direct “Chat on WhatsApp” button, allowing customers to easily switch from the bot to your personal support channel.
  • Store Policy & Context: Define your store’s context (shipping, returns, brand voice). The AI uses this to answer general inquiries accurately.
  • Intelligent Message Queue: If the AI cannot reply for any reason, messages are instantly saved to the admin panel. You can reply manually, and the user receives the answer in the chat window immediately.
  • Full Customization (Free): Customize Bot Name, Greeting Message, Launcher Icon (presets), Profile Picture, Animations, Colors, Typography, and Position.
  • Pro Customization: (Pro) users can rename/translate all UI text labels and upload Custom Hero Background images.
  • Lightning Fast Performance: Uses advanced server-side language detection to minimize frontend payload size, ensuring your site loads instantly.
  • Product Recommendations: Displays “View Product” buttons for recommended items based on user queries.
  • Visibility Control: Option to hide on specific WooCommerce pages or devices (Mobile/Desktop).
  • Advanced Actions: “Add to Cart” button directly in chat and Custom Icon Uploads are available in (Pro).

📦 AI Store Indexing Technology

To ensure the Chatbot provides accurate recommendations, the plugin uses an advanced indexing system that creates a compressed “knowledge base” of your products.

  • Smart Cataloging: Scans and indexes standard product data (Titles, Prices, Short Descriptions, Categories, Stock Status).
  • Performance Focused: Uses data compression (GZIP) and batch processing to handle large catalogs efficiently.
  • Filtering: Configure Date Filters and Stock Status filters to control which products are indexed.
  • Advanced Data: Indexing of SKU, Full Descriptions, Tags, Attributes, and Stock Quantity is available in (Pro).
  • Automation: Scheduled Automatic Index Updates and Multi-Index Profiles are available in (Pro).

🚀 AI Automation Jobs

Transform manual work into automated workflows using the built-in job scheduler.
* Set & Forget: Configure your prompt settings and start the bulk process.
* Smart Filtering: Filter by price range and specific product IDs. Now supports AND/OR logic for precise targeting.
* Resilient State Management: Tracks job status with auto-resume functionality.
* Real-time Monitoring: View accurate progress bars and estimated completion times.
* Cost Control: Options to auto-pause generation to manage API usage effectively.
* Safety: Automatic Content Backup before generation (Pro).
* Advanced Filtering: Filter by category, stock status, product status, and tags (Pro).

⚡ Dual Bulk Description System

The toolkit offers two distinct bulk modes for product descriptions:

1. Standard Bulk Generator (Basic)
* Unlimited usage (subject to provider limits).
* Generates clean, plain text output.
* Fast and efficient for simple bulk operations.
* Full Content Preview: Review generated text instantly before saving.
* Supports Tone/Style settings and Custom Prompts.

2. Advanced Bulk Generator (Professional)
* Rich Output: Generates SEO-focused HTML output with structured markup.
* External Optimization Service: Advanced generation is powered by AI Smart Parameters™ technology (credit-based).
* AI Smart Parameters™: Automatically configures model settings based on content type.
* Custom Fields Integration: Map existing custom fields to variables (e.g., {custom1}).
* Edit Before Approve: Review and modify content in bulk before it goes live.
* Content Improvement: Option to enhance existing descriptions (rewrite/expand) rather than overwriting them.

🎯 Specialized Bulk Tools

Bulk AI Product Title Generator
Create SEO-friendly product titles for thousands of products at once.
* Generation Mode: Default “Rewrite” mode using product data.
* Length Control: Set custom character or word limits.
* Tone Selection: Standard SEO-optimized tone.
* Data Sources: Uses product descriptions as the source.
* Advanced Modes: “Improve Title” mode and Specialized Tones (Professional, Urgent, Luxury) (Pro).
* Keyword Targeting: Enforce specific focus keywords in titles (Pro).
* Custom Sources: Custom data source integration (Pro).
* Customization: Additional System Prompt options (Pro).

Bulk AI Product FAQ Generator
Automatically generate Questions and Answers based on product data.
* Output: Generates complete “Question + Answer” pairs.
* Quantity Control: Set custom number of FAQs per product.
* Write Mode: Appends FAQs to existing content.
* Contextual Analysis: Uses product descriptions as the reference source.
* Targeting: Saves to Description field.
* Advanced Modes: Separate “Question Only” / “Answer Only” modes and “Rewrite” mode (Pro).
* Advanced Context: Advanced source selection (Pro).
* Custom Targeting: Saving to specific Custom Fields (Pro).
* Customization: Additional System Prompt options (Pro).

Bulk Smart Product Tag Generation
Analyze product data to generate relevant tags for better internal search and discoverability. Includes bulk generation and history tracking.

🛠 Toolkit Dashboard & Integration

Centralized Control Center
Access all tools (Automation, Bulk Generators, Title, FAQ) from a single dashboard. Includes quick settings access and store insights.

Large Catalog Support
Includes a custom pagination system allowing users to jump to any page instantly and control the number of products displayed per page (10, 25, 50, 100+).

Acknowledgments

Thank you for choosing AI Product Tools to enhance your WooCommerce store with AI-powered solutions. We appreciate your trust in us and are committed to helping you streamline your workflow 😊🙏

🔒 Privacy & Third-Party Services

This plugin utilizes external services to provide AI content generation and chatbot features.

1. AI Content Providers
Product data (titles, descriptions, attributes, categories, etc.) and chat messages are sent to your selected provider solely to generate content/responses.
* OpenAI: Terms | Privacy
* Google Gemini: Terms | Privacy
* OpenRouter: Terms | Privacy

2. AI Smart Parameters™ (Advanced Generator Only)
Connects to our external service to optimize AI generation settings.
* Data Sent: Site URL, admin email, plugin version, and usage statistics.
* Policies: Our Privacy Policy | Terms

Security Note: Your third-party API keys are stored encrypted locally in your WordPress database and are never shared with us.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Complete the onboarding wizard by selecting your preferred AI provider (OpenAI, Gemini AI or OpenRouter) and entering your API key (you can also configure these later via Settings)
  4. Visit the Toolkit Dashboard to explore available tools
  5. Customize your prompt settings and generation preferences
  6. Start using the plugin to generate and enhance your product content
sections.faq:
Is AI Product Tools free to use?

The plugin offers extensive functionality in the free version:
* AI Shop Assistant: Free chatbot with full appearance customization, multi-language support, and product recommendations (View Product button).
* Standard Bulk Generator: Unlimited plain text generation.
* Title & FAQ Generators: Free generation with standard settings.
* Automation Jobs: Free scheduling with basic filtering.
Pro plans unlock advanced chatbot features (“Add to Cart” button, Custom CSS, Scheduled Indexing), advanced bulk generation, and more.

How does the AI Chatbot know about my products?

The plugin uses the AI Store Index feature. It scans your product titles, prices, categories, and stock status to create a compressed data file. The AI uses this index to find and recommend relevant products during a conversation.

Does the Chatbot slow down my site?

No. It utilizes an efficient server-side language detection system that reduces the frontend payload by 99% (approx. 5KB). It loads asynchronously and uses a compressed index structure (GZIP), making it one of the lightest chatbots on the market.

Can I customize the Chatbot’s appearance?

Yes. The free version allows extensive customization including Bot Name, Welcome Message, Colors, Typography, Position, and built-in Launcher Icons. The Pro version unlocks advanced visual controls, including Custom Hero Background images, Custom Icon uploads, and the ability to rename or translate all UI text labels.

What is the difference between Standard and Advanced Generators?

  • Standard: Unlimited usage, plain text output, supports tone settings and custom prompts. Ideal for quick, simple descriptions.
  • Advanced: Generates HTML-rich content with structured markup. It features custom fields integration, history tracking, content improvement mode, and utilizes the external AI Smart Parameters™ system for automatic optimization (credit-based).

Can I edit content before publishing?

Yes. All generation tools (Standard, Advanced, Title, and FAQ) include an “Edit Before Approve” workflow. This allows you to review, modify, and polish the AI-generated content in bulk before saving it to your live products.

How do Custom Fields work?

You can map existing WooCommerce custom fields (compatible with Advanced Custom Fields / ACF plugin) to variables like {custom1}. These variables can be inserted into your prompt templates, allowing the AI to include specific data points (materials, dimensions, internal codes) in the generated text. Note: Custom Field mapping is available in Advanced Generator, Title, and FAQ tools.

How does the AI Smart Parameters™ technology work?

Available in the Advanced Generator, this external optimization service automatically configures technical AI settings (temperature, top_p, presence penalty) based on the specific model and content type being generated. This eliminates the need for manual configuration to achieve optimal results.

Does this plugin work with large catalogs?

Yes. The plugin includes a custom pagination system for navigating thousands of products and uses WP-Cron for background processing. This prevents server timeouts and ensures stability even when processing massive product lists.

What is OpenRouter and why should I use it?

OpenRouter is an AI gateway that allows you to access hundreds of models beyond just OpenAI. It includes many free-to-use models (like Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, etc.) which allow you to generate content at zero cost. It also supports premium models like Claude Sonnet 4 and Grok 4. You can connect your OpenRouter key directly in the plugin settings.

Is my data secure?

Yes. We prioritize security:
1.  Local Storage: API keys are encrypted in your database.
2.  Direct Transmission: Data goes directly to the AI Provider (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.).
3.  Zero Access: We do not have access to your product content or chat logs.
